title: Latent slot collapse: investigation and mitigation plan for continuous batcher regressions
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Summary: On 2025-01-17 we observed a series of capacity/latency regressions in the continuous batching layer (hosted in eu-west). Symptoms included sustained tail latency spikes (p99+), throughput drop for medium-length requests (sequences 512-2048), and request-level unfairness where small requests dominated available GPU slots. Impact: 18% request failure increase for affected customers, multiple mid-tier customers reported degraded SLA adherence. This ticket captures the investigation, immediate mitigations applied, and a prioritized set of action items to prevent recurrence.

Timeline: 2025-01-17 03:12 UTC - Spike begins coincident with a dedicated pool resize event; 03:18 UTC - alerting fires for p99 latency; 03:25 UTC - mitigation 1 (roll back prioritization change) deployed; 04:05 UTC - hotfix (slot reconciliation on heartbeat) rolled; 05:00 UTC - full traffic normalization observed.

Root cause hypothesis: An interaction between the new request-priority preemption heuristic (deployed 2025-01-10) and slot accounting reconciliation produced a transient "latent slot collapse" in the batch coordinator. The coordinator's in-memory slot counts drifted from worker leases after a race on slot reclamation during a scaling event, causing the coordinator to believe many slots were consumed when they were not. That led to a) suppressed batch formation windows, b) opportunistic stealing by short requests that bypassed batching, and c) per-model fairness skew.

Evidence: Reproducer run in staging recreated the drift by forcing concurrent worker scale-down + priority preemption; logs show slot_delta mismatches and missing lease refresh acknowledgements. Telemetry shows an increase in coordinator->worker reconciliation errors during the window.

Why this is unique from past incidents: Unlike earlier coalescer stalls, this was triggered by a cluster topology change (scale down) combined with a non-idempotent slot preemption code path — not purely timer drift or queue livelock.
action_items: Hotfix backport: ensure coordinator performs immediate slot reconciliation on any worker reconnect; owner: Miguel Santos; ETA: 2025-01-25
Revert/guard: add feature flag gating for priority preemption to disable when cluster resize detected; owner: Priya Nair; ETA: 2025-01-30
Short-term circuit: when queue occupancy < X for >Yms, bypass preemption and bias towards forming first batch; owner: Daniel Wong; ETA: 2025-02-07
Idempotent leases: change slot allocation protocol to lease tokens with explicit ack semantics and idempotent renewals; owner: Platform infra team; ETA: 2025-03-15
Periodic reconciliation: baseline heartbeats to run reconciliation + corrective reconciliation delta counters every 10s; owner: Miguel Santos; ETA: 2025-02-10
Fairness dashboards: add per-model and per-request-size fairness metrics and alert when skew > 2x baseline; owner: Observability team (Laura Chen); ETA: 2025-02-14
Chaos test: add a scaling+preemption chaos test to CI to prevent regressions; owner: SRE (Noah Patel); ETA: 2025-02-21
Postmortem writeup and customer comms: publish detailed postmortem & targeted customer notes for affected accounts; owner: Asha Kapoor; ETA: 2025-02-06
followups: Design review scheduled 2025-01-28 to pick long-term lease design and roll strategy
Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag with canary on non-critical tenants, monitor fairness and p99 for 48h
Dependency cleanup: re-audit related batching heuristics (priority preemption, small-request fastpath, autoscale hooks) and consolidate guards
Regression test addition: add scenario to eval harness that simulates concurrent scale-down + burst of mixed-size requests
